candidate_only_note: The candidate-only column is a constrained continuation benchmark, not a claim about every possible Hard Mode history.
description: Every 3+-answer working-pool family that differs in exactly one position, with bounded probe and candidate-only recommendations.
method: Enumerate all one-slot families of size at least three. Score the 2,500 provenance-bound heuristic splitters plus missing family members; separately score family members only.
